description:
A stress monitor for iPhone and Apple Watch, built on your heart rate variability (HRV).

Stress AI Coach turns the HRV, sleep and activity data your Apple Watch and iPhone already collect into one clear stress score from 0 to 100. Ripple, a calm otter companion, helps you act on it.

YOUR STRESS, SCORED
• A 0–100 score in five levels: Relaxed, Mild, Elevated, High and Severe
• Built from five factors: heart rate variability, heart rate, sleep, activity and recovery
• Scored on your device from Apple Health. Nothing to set up, no manual logging
• A confidence level with every reading

RIPPLE, YOUR OTTER COACH
• Ripple shows how your body feels, one look for each stress level
• Chat with Ripple about your readings, trends and patterns
• Get a reset that fits the moment: breathing, a short walk or a quick reflection

CALM IN MINUTES
• Guided box breathing on iPhone and 4-7-8 breathing on Apple Watch
• Mini walks for a quick reset
• Mood check-ins and daily habits

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
• A weekly summary that compares your stress with the week before
• A weekly insight from Ripple

ON APPLE WATCH AND WIDGETS
• Apple Watch app with your current score, breathing sessions and history
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus watch complications

PRIVACY FIRST
• Stress scoring happens on your device
• Ripple only sees derived scores, never your raw health data
• Health sync is optional, asks first, and can be turned off anytime

Stress AI Coach is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat any condition. Talk to a doctor about any health concern.

Requires iPhone with iOS 18.6 or later. Apple Health access is optional but recommended for scoring.

Questions or feedback: support@stressmonitor.app
Privacy Policy: https://stressmonitor-docs.vercel.app/legal/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Meet the new Ripple. Your otter coach now shows how your day feels, from Relaxed to Severe. Check your HRV stress score at a glance and reset with a 2-minute breath.
whatsNew:
This update brings a fresh look and a new Ripple.

• Meet the new Ripple: your otter coach now has a look for every stress level, from Relaxed to Severe, plus a new app icon
• A redesigned app: clearer Home, Action, Trends and Settings screens, with a refreshed Apple Watch app and widgets
• New Plus subscription: unlimited chats with Ripple, every chart, and 30- and 90-day trends
• When data is missing, the app now shows an empty state instead of sample numbers
• Fixes: Mini Walk no longer closes when you pause or end it, the breathing summary opens after a session, and the Haptics setting is saved
